sentences.text: Shri S.K. Mishra - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Ajay Tamrakar - Panel Lawyer for the State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicants under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.56/2022 dated 07.03.2024 registered at Police Station -Mohangarh, District Tikamgarh for the offence under Sections 366, 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and Section 5L/6, 16/17, 21 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant contends that the only allegation against the present applicant that she was instrumental in commission of offence which was committed by the main accused.
The prosecutrix is aged about 17 years and 2 months and the present applicant is aged about 22 years is in custody since 17.06.2024, deserve to be enlarged on bail.

3. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submitted that the present applicant assisted the main accused to commit the offence, therefore, no case for grant of bail is made out.

4. Considering the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties and perusal of the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of 2 MCRC-26444-2024 Cr.P.C. reflects that the only allegation against the present applicant is that she facilitated the victim to be in touch with the main accused.
The applicant is aged about 22 years and is in custody since 17.06.2024.
Considering the totality of the circumstances, the application is allowed.

5. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on their furnishing personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with solvent surety in the like amount to the Smt Shashi Sen vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184984087/
1

6. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
7.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
